articles.title: Backblaze explains why it's sharing customer information with advertisers
articles.content: Backblaze tells Ars it won't share users' backup, storage files with advertisers.
articles.titleZh: Backblaze解释了为何要与广告商共享客户信息
articles.contentZh: Backblaze 告诉 Ars，它不会与广告商共享用户的备份和存储文件。

articles.title: Amazon says hackers' AI agents found and exploited 0-day with little human input
articles.content: The Cairn AI framework is proving to be a boon for defenders and attackers.
articles.titleZh: 亚马逊表示，黑客的AI代理在几乎没有人为干预的情况下发现了0-day漏洞并进行了利用
articles.contentZh: 事实证明，Cairn AI框架对防御者和攻击者来说都是一大福音。

articles.title: Researcher plants 2m canaries into the AI supply chain. A privacy disaster surfaced.
articles.content: Test using prompts with unique, trackable secrets proves that data doesn't stay private.
articles.titleZh: 研究人员在人工智能供应链中植入了 200 万只“金丝雀”。一场隐私灾难浮出水面。
articles.contentZh: 使用包含唯一、可追踪密钥的提示进行测试，结果证明数据无法保持私密性。

articles.title: Man hired by Russia spied on Silicon Valley tech and defense company, feds say
articles.content: 25-year-old accused of stalking employees at coffee shop and in an "aggressive" car pursuit.
articles.titleZh: 联邦调查局称，一名受雇于俄罗斯的男子曾对硅谷的科技和国防公司进行间谍活动
articles.contentZh: 25岁男子被指控在咖啡店尾随员工，并“咄咄逼人”地驾车追逐。
